questions.question: Iinyathi set a database record (05/06 season, List A) with a value of 331. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Iinyathi.

questions.question: At St George's Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
At which ground did Zenande Nonqayi record their career-best innings (55, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2024/03/16.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Lions?
South Africa Women played their first ODI in August 1997, 25 years after their last Test before an extended absence from international cricket. Who was the opponent, and where was it played?
questions.explanation: South Africa's first ODI after readmission to international cricket was against Ireland at Stormont, Belfast, on 5 August 1997.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.
